item.title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Upgrade Kit (Standard Edition)
item.description:
Title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Upgrade Kit (Standard Edition)
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG
Developer: Cygames, Inc.
Publisher: Cygames, Inc.
Franchise: Granblue Fantasy
Release Date: Jul 8, 2026




About This Content

*This product is intended for players who already own Granblue Fantasy: Relink.
*The Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Upgrade Kit can be used to upgrade your copy of Granblue Fantasy: Relink on the same platform.
*Content may change without prior notice.
*This title is in development and subject to change.

Known for its dynamic combat, ensemble of versatile characters, and thrilling online co-op, Relink returns with expanded solo and multiplayer content, bringing endless adventure to skyfarers both new and old.

Major Additions in Endless Ragnarok
From new stories to game modes, Relink has been refined and revamped for the ultimate action RPG experience.

Embark on new adventures.
Although the Astral Lilith's machinations lay thwarted, winds of change begin to stir within the Zegagrande Skydom... Strange beings called the "ragnalia" herald the end times. Mysterious gateways beckon would-be challengers into a realm of chaos. And even the mighty Beelzebub, with his wings of steel, descends upon Zegagrande.

Call in the big guns.
During their journey, players will unlock the ability to equip and call forth summons, adding a new dimension to battle strategy. Once channeled by Lyria, some summons can be temporarily controlled by the player; but if certain conditions are met, others will make a spectacular entrance alongside a new type of chain burst—the "primal burst."

More to master, more to play.
• New co-op quest tiers and additional bosses.
• The Conflux, an all-new solo mode where unpredictable challenges and enigmatic powers lurk within its depths.
• The introduction of master traits to push characters beyond their limits.
• Summons to expand on tactical options.
All of these features—and more—ensure that even after the credits roll, Relink's skies remain vast!

Play across boundaries.
Relink's thrilling 4-player online co-op combat reaches new heights with crossplay across all platforms!


Early Purchase Bonus
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Supplementary Damage V & War Elemental Sigil Set

Contents:
A set of rare sigils to support you during battles against powerful foes.
• Supplementary Damage V Sigil
• War Elemental Sigil

*Purchase must be made by 11:59 p.m., Aug 31, 2026 (local time) in order to receive pre-order bonuses.
*This bonus can only be claimed once per user account.
*The full game of the game is required to use in-game items. You may be required to update the game to the latest patch before use.
Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit Required)
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-9100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 3200G
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX™ 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580 8GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 90 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended (Capable of 1080p/30fps when graphics are set to Standard.)
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit Required)
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 2080 8GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT 8GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 90 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended (Capable of 1080p/60fps when graphics are set to Ultra.)

item.title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok (Special Edition)
item.description:
Informații despre dezvoltator indisponibile.



About the Package

*This product is intended for players who do not own Granblue Fantasy: Relink.
*It includes both Granblue Fantasy: Relink and the Granblue Fantasy Relink: Endless Ragnarok Upgrade Kit.
*Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok (Special Edition) comes with various in-game items that can help you along your journey, including weapons, character color packs, emotes, and more.

Contents:
Granblue Fantasy: Relink
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Upgrade Kit
Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Special Pack
Includes special character colors for the captain, Id, and Sandalphon. Also comes with useful items for unlocking Seofon, Tweyen, and Sandalphon.
• Concept Art Color Pack
- The Captain (Gran/Djeeta)
- Id
- Sandalphon
• Azurite's Splendor x 5
• Canaan Whitebloom x 3
• Supreme Weapon Essence x 6

Granblue Fantasy: Relink DLC Collection
This is a collection of previously released downloadable content for Granblue Fantasy: Relink. It includes useful items for making upgrades, 5 sets of colors for characters, and 3 sets of emotes.
• Ignition Pack
- Weapon: False Sword of the Apocalypse
- Glittercrystal x 30
- 500 MSP
- Fortitude Crystal (S) x 50
• Color Packs 1-5
• Emote Expansion Sets: Let's Chat, I Work Out, Grab Bag

*In-game items can be claimed by speaking with Sierokarte in town and selecting Claim Add-Ons from the menu.
*The Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Upgrade Pack has been renamed to the Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Ignition Pack. This is a name change only—no changes have been made to pack contents.
*In-game items included with this product can only be claimed once per account.
*Content may change without prior notice.
*This title is in development and subject to change.


Known for its dynamic combat, ensemble of versatile characters, and thrilling online co-op, Relink returns with expanded solo and multiplayer content, bringing endless adventure to skyfarers both new and old.

Story

Our tale begins in the Sky Realm, where myriad islands float in a sea of clouds. Led by an intrepid captain, a band of skyfarers seek the mythical island of Estalucia. Their adventures, ushered by some fateful wind, would lead them toward a forgotten corner of the Sky Realm: Zegagrande Skydom.

Gameplay Features

Band together for exhilarating battles.
Form a party of four and depart for battle in this epic action RPG. Each character sports distinct combat mechanics, allowing for a whole crewful of unique playstyles. Weave these playstyles together using satisfying party-based attacks—like link attacks and chain bursts—to really make combat soar. Even recruits fresh to action gaming can take advantage of Assist Mode to reach the story's heart-pounding conclusion.

Embark on an endless variety of co-op quests.
A wide range of quests become available as the adventure unfolds. From unique boss fights to horde-survival missions, all quests are playable offline or online with up to four players. Whether it's casual questing or ultra-challenging end content, there's something for everyone to enjoy.

Major Additions in Endless Ragnarok
From new stories to game modes, Relink has been refined and revamped for the ultimate action RPG experience.

Embark on new adventures.
Although the Astral Lilith's machinations lay thwarted, winds of change begin to stir within the Zegagrande Skydom... Strange beings called the ""ragnalia"" herald the end times. • The Conflux, an all-new solo mode where unpredictable challenges and enigmatic powers lurk within its depths.
• The introduction of master traits to push characters beyond their limits.
• Summons to expand on tactical options.

Play across boundaries.

A set of sigils tailored to support early- and mid-game progression.

item.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods
item.description:
Title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Gameloft
Publisher: Gameloft
Franchise: Gameloft
Release Date: Jul 8, 2026




About This Content

Includes 2,000 Moonstones

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods is a brand-new Adventure Pack for Disney Dreamlight Valley , perfect for newcomers to the Valley or seasoned Dreamlight players. Befriend 3 beloved Winnie the Pooh Characters, explore and decorate 4 brand-new areas, and solve puzzles in the mysterious Everoak Tree. Reconnect with childlike curiosity, rediscover the joys of friendship with a playful game of Pooh Sticks, and bring a touch of honey to your Valley as you perfect the art of beekeeping, which unlocks dozens of new crafting recipes!

Meet Friends Old and New

Deep within Dreamlight Valley lies the Honeyglow Woods, where you once spent lazy afternoons with long-lost friends. Rediscover this idyllic place, and you’ll quickly find Winnie the Pooh, radiating with optimism even on the gloomiest days. Nearby, the courageous Piglet is ready to face his fears, and the thoughtful Eeyore quietly accepts the Woods' melancholy... though a little cheering up would be most welcome!

This whimsical world isn't just about reconnecting with old friends; you'll also be making new ones. Befriend a delightful family of colorful hedgehogs, ready to join you on your adventures.

A Touch of Sweetness

At the heart of the Honeyglow Woods lies its golden secret: honey! Learn the art of beekeeping, crafting Busy Bees’ Houses and placing them among vibrant flowers to gather Golden Honey. Use it to create whimsical Honeyglow Furniture, bake delicious treats, and unlock new recipes. You'll soon be spreading a little sweetness to every corner of the Valley.

The Mystery of the Everoak Tree

The Everoak Tree stands tall in the middle of the Woods, surrounded by four entirely unique, enchanting areas. Wander through Drowsybloom Acre, venture into the blooming Braveheart Grove, wade through the delightfully swampy Gloommeadow, and step into the Nectar Apiary and its giant honeycombs. As you restore each area and uncover the secrets within the Everoak Tree, you'll mend the land and unravel the mystery at the heart of the Honeyglow Woods.

A brand-new mini-game!

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods includes a brand-new mini-game you can play with all your Villagers: Pooh Sticks, inspired by the game as it appears in classic Winnie the Pooh stories! To play Pooh Sticks, find a bridge in the Gloommeadow and gather four Villagers. Each will choose an object and drop it over the bridge downstream. Whoever's object reaches the finish line on the river first wins! Pooh Sticks is a wholesome new way of creating lasting friendship bonds with your friends and neighbors in the Valley.

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-540 or AMD Phenom II X4 940
    • Memory: 6 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 9600 GT, 512 MB or AMD Radeon HD 6570, 1 GB
    • DirectX: Version 10
    • Storage: 15 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 or AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
    • Memory: 6 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960, 4 GB or AMD Radeon R9 380, 4 GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 15 GB available space

This whimsical world isn't just about reconnecting with old friends; you'll also be making new ones. Befriend a delightful family of colorful hedgehogs, ready to join you on your adventures.

A Touch of Sweetness

At the heart of the Honeyglow Woods lies its golden secret: honey! Learn the art of beekeeping, crafting Busy Bees’ Houses and placing them among vibrant flowers to gather Golden Honey. Use it to create whimsical Honeyglow Furniture, bake delicious treats, and unlock new recipes. You'll soon be spreading a little sweetness to every corner of the Valley.

The Mystery of the Everoak Tree

The Everoak Tree stands tall in the middle of the Woods, surrounded by four entirely unique, enchanting areas. Wander through Drowsybloom Acre, venture into the blooming Braveheart Grove, wade through the delightfully swampy Gloommeadow, and step into the Nectar Apiary and its giant honeycombs. As you restore each area and uncover the secrets within the Everoak Tree, you'll mend the land and unravel the mystery at the heart of the Honeyglow Woods.

A brand-new mini-game!

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods includes a brand-new mini-game you can play with all your Villagers: Pooh Sticks, inspired by the game as it appears in classic Winnie the Pooh stories! To play Pooh Sticks, find a bridge in the Gloommeadow and gather four Villagers. Each will choose an object and drop it over the bridge downstream. Whoever's object reaches the finish line on the river first wins! Pooh Sticks is a wholesome new way of creating lasting friendship bonds with your friends and neighbors in the Valley.

item.description:
Title: NTE: Neverness to Everness
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG , Free To Play
Developer: Hotta Studio
Publisher: Perfect World Games
Release Date: Jul 7, 2026




About This Game

NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures

Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

Breaking News: Taygedo's romance crisis! Romance and impulse, heartbreak and missed chances—Miss Tako, the object of a secret crush, is about to leave Hethereau with her guarantor. How will the lovestruck otter get his feelings across before it's too late?

Reliable Insider Tip: Film Orbit Studio is back in business! Members of the Eibon Antique Shop get exclusive discounts!

Weather Update: The Anomaly Rainman is entering an active phase—don't forget your rain gear on the way out!

That wraps up today's 10AM broadcast. Stay tuned for mysterious Anomalies, unbreakable "Oaths," and the ever-growing shadow of the colossal "Circle" organization, looming larger in the fragmented echoes of "Prophecies"...

◆ Encounters and Bonds

Explore hidden shops tucked away in back alleys and meet their enigmatic owners, along with absurdly overpowered bodyguards, "jack-of-all-trades" robotic butlers, troublemakers who can't help finding problems, and TV-headed repairmen with some very curious eating habits.

As part of the Eibon crew, you'll never be short on energetic companions for the road ahead.

Expand your social circle starting from the bustling Hankaku Street! Meet members from different factions and add them as "Bagel" friends!

From the tight-knit neighborhood of street shops to the city's unique hunter organizations, countless side stories await—ready for you to make friends and forge bonds across every corner of Hethereau.

◆ Customize Your Urban Lifestyle

Explore the city on your own terms—stick to familiar routines or shake things up.

Customize your ride and tear through the city streets, or hop on the Ghost Train to cut through Anomaly space and arrive in a flash.

In your downtime, swing by the old shops on Hankaku Street to browse their secret seasonal stock, or buy a cozy little home and deck it out to your liking.

Go at your own pace, follow your instincts, and let Hethereau reward you with colorful days worth remembering.

    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit

    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
